messages:
Priya M.: quick one from the finance interview yesterday 13: users want "quick exports" presets (monthly PDF, raw CSV, tokens CSV) accessible from the spend header. they kept saying 'one tap, get my usual file'.

Jonas (Design): sketched a compact menu: right of the invoice CTA a chevron opens "Quick exports" with 3 presets, plus "Manage presets". mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/quick-exports. idea is to avoid extra modal on mobile.

Ibrahim: +1. important: presets should capture scope/timeframe. e.g., "Org - Last Month PDF" should download the filtered report. also allow renamed presets like "Finance monthly".

Nora (PM): product questions: who can create/manage presets? org-admins only? teams? propose roles: org-admins and billing-managers can save org-level presets, project-owners can save project presets. track owner metadata in telemetry.

Jonas (Design): accessibility: menu must be keyboard-navigable and announce preset details (scope, format). menu items should include aria-describedby with the preset description.

QA-bot: checklist item: ensure keyboard focus stays in menu while its open, Escape closes, Enter triggers download. Test VoiceOver readout for preset labels.

Priya M.: microcopy: default preset names should be human-friendly, e.g., "Org monthly PDF (Jan 2026)". invoice filename pattern: <preset-name>_<org>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.pdf to help users who download many reports.

Ibrahim: impl note: server needs endpoint to materialize presets into files and include preset id in telemetry. also add a preview action that shows the first 10 rows of CSV before download.

Nora (PM): experiment idea: Variant A = quick presets menu in header + compact numeric tokens; Variant B = no presets (use FAB) + bubble chart default. measure time-to-download and repeat-download rate.

Jonas (Design): also thinking about discoverability: show a subtle "Recently used" row in the menu for quick access. include icons (PDF/CSV/token) and small timestamps.

Priya M.: privacy ask: preset names containing sensitive project names should be editable and permissioned. e.g., finance team only. add server-side access checks.

Ibrahim: agreed. add audit log entry when preset is created/edited/deleted. filenames should avoid leaking IDs. use slugs.

QA-bot: test case: preset creation + download on small viewport, keyboard-only, screen reader, and pinned preset flow.

Nora (PM): timeline: can we prototype header menu + server stub next sprint? will prioritize preset CRUD and telemetry.

Jonas (Design): I'll push small frames and include aria labels and focus styles. tagging @eng-frontend and @security. :sparkles:

Priya M.: thanks all 1: let's close after PR and Figma are linked.
